SpasiX — Setup & trading

SpasiX • BUILD 2026-10-25a • MetaTrader 5 (IC Markets) on Windows • LIVE • PROP • BACKTEST

Updating from build 24c (3 minutes)

  • Close the old SpasiX. Replace SpasiX.exe with the new one (same folder as before, not inside MT5).
  • Copy the new SpasiXBridge.mq5 (v4) into MT5's MQL5\Experts folder (replace the old file) and restart MT5.
  • On the chart with the bridge: remove the old bridge (right-click → Expert list → Remove) and drag SpasiXBridge on again → in its window tick Allow Algo Trading (Common tab) → OK. Its new input EnableTrading is true already.
  • Turn ON Algo Trading in the MT5 toolbar (green). Start SpasiX → the start screen asks LIVE / PROP / BACKTEST.

1First time only: the bridge in MT5

  • MT5 → File → Open Data Folder → MQL5 → Experts → paste SpasiXBridge.mq5 → restart MT5.
  • MT5 → Tools → Options → Expert Advisors → tick Allow WebRequest for listed URL → add http://127.0.0.1.
  • For deep backtest history: Tools → Options → Charts → Max bars in chart = Unlimited.
  • Drag SpasiXBridge onto ONE chart → tick Allow Algo Trading → OK. Start SpasiX.exe (first time: allow the .NET 8 Desktop Runtime; "Windows protected your PC" → More info → Run anyway).

2The start screen

  • 📈 LIVE — your MT5 account in real time. 🏆 PROP — a CFD prop-firm account on MT5 with the firm's rules on screen. 🧪 BACKTEST — MT5's own history replayed (works without MT5 once the days are downloaded).
  • Keys 1 / 2 / 3 choose. ⌂ MODES in the header brings you back here.

3The chart

  • Symbols (cyan) — ● = you have tickets on it • + = add any instrument of your broker. Timeframes (gold) M1 … W1. ▣ 1 / ◫ 2 / ⊞ 4 = split screen.
  • 📈 INDICATORS ▾ — tick them, each with its name and colour: EMA 9 / 21 / 50 / 200, VWAP, Bollinger, fair-value gaps, NY opening range, yesterday high / low, sessions (Asia / London / New York) and SpasiX setups (a sweep of a swing high / low that closes back and breaks; the live one blinks with its entry, stop and 2R target; its record — wins, %, expectancy — is shown on the chart).
  • 🎨 8 themes • 🕘 time zone (New York, London, …, MT5's server).
  • Colours: buys = mint, sells = red, pending orders = amber, the price = white with a pulse on every new price. Point at a line: it lights up and flashes once, and a card shows the ticket (P/L, swap, its stop / target in $).
  • Drawing rail (left): cursor, horizontal line / ray, vertical line, trend line / ray, rectangle, Fibonacci, text, long / short position (risk / reward with your lots, in $), measure, 🧲 magnet, colour, 🗑. Right-click a drawing: colour, width, dashed, text, place it as an order, duplicate, delete.
  • Mouse: wheel = zoom • drag the chart = move • drag the time axis = stretch • drag the price axis = stretch the price • double-click = back to now • right-click = the menu (on a ticket: close, half, breakeven, stop / target here; on an order: move here / cancel) • F11 = full screen.

4Trading — please test on a DEMO first

  • The trade panel shows a ✓ / ✖ for every switch: bridge v4, EnableTrading, Algo Trading (toolbar), Allow Algo Trading (the bridge), the account. All green → 🔓 ARM TRADING → it asks (red for a REAL account). Armed until DISARM or closing SpasiX.
  • LOTS, optional STOP / TARGET distance (the panel shows the risk / reward in $) → SELL / BUY — each asks first, showing the size big (one-click only up to 2 lots, if you switch it on).
  • Limit / stop: BUY LIMIT / SELL LIMIT / BUY STOP / SELL STOP → type the price or 🎯 PICK on the chart → PLACE. Or right-click the chart at a price.
  • On the chart: ✕ closes (asks) • drag a ticket line = sets its stop / target • drag a stop / target = moves it • drag an order = new price. Many tickets fold into one label per side (right-click ▸ Tickets on the chart).
  • MANAGE: close all / buys / sells / winners / losers / orders • ⚖ breakeven (+ points) • ⛔ close everything. 💼 POSITIONS: every ticket with ✕, ½, S/L, T/P, ⚖.
  • MaxLotsPerOrder in the bridge caps every order. Set EnableTrading = false to make SpasiX read only.

5🧪 Backtest studio

  • 📂 DATA: the symbol, the days (or LAST 5 / 10 / 20, THIS / LAST WEEK, LAST MONTH), the warm-up days, the start time; the account: balance, leverage, commission per lot, spread (REAL from MT5's candles or fixed), slippage, swap, stop-out → ▶ START (it downloads the missing days from MT5 once and keeps them on this PC).
  • The replay bar: ⏮ restart • ▶ / ⏸ (Space) • ⏭ one candle (→) • speed 1× … 1000× / MAX • ⏩ London / NY open / next day • the New York clock and the progress.
  • Trade exactly like live (hedging, limits, stops, drag the lines). 📊 STATS = the tracker of the run; past runs are listed in DATA.

6🏆 PROP and 📊 TRACKER

  • PROP: press a preset (FTMO / The5ers / FundedNext / E8) or type your firm's numbers: account size, daily loss, max loss (static or trailing), target, days, consistency. The header shows the meters; SpasiX refuses a new entry at a limit or when the order's stop risks more than what is left today (closes always work).
  • TRACKER: the calendar of every day (net after commission and swap), the week totals, win rate, profit factor, expectancy, best / worst day, drawdown, the equity curve, P/L by NY hour / weekday / symbol, the day's trades and a journal note per day.
  • MARKET, NEWS (ForexFactory calendar + live headlines), 👁 STREAM = only your name and account number are blurred.

If something is not right

  • A red ✖ line in the trade panel says which switch is off. The TRACKER / backtest download need bridge v4.
  • An order answered "✖ …" = MT5's own reason (market closed, invalid stops, not enough margin, …).
  • Chart corner "waiting for the SpasiX app (error 5272)" → start SpasiX.exe.
